title: Brainstem Substructures Atlas — brainstem
text: Atlas four FreeSurfer brainstem substructures (midbrain, pons, medulla oblongata superior cerebellar peduncle), implemented FreeSurfer's segment_subregions brainstem (Iglesias et al. 2015). Built cvs_avg35 template segmentation embedded full-brain aseg, slice views show brainstem inside cerebral cortex white matter (rendered grey anatomical context). Substructure colours come FreeSurfer's official LUT.

title: Anterior/Posterior Hippocampus Atlas — hcpa
text: Atlas hippocampus split anterior (head) posterior (body tail) part per hemisphere, common HCP-style long-axis subdivision. boundary midpoint hippocampus's anterior-posterior extent FreeSurfer aseg. Built fsaverage5 aseg, slice views show hippocampus inside cerebral cortex white matter (rendered grey anatomical context).

what: Hippocampal Subfields & Amygdala Nuclei Atlas — hippoamyg
title: Hippocampal Subfields & Amygdala Nuclei Atlas — hippoamyg
text: FreeSurfer segmentation hippocampal subfields (Iglesias et al. 2015) nuclei amygdala (Saygin et al. 2017), produced segment_subregions hippo-amygdala. Built cvs_avg35 template segmentation embedded fsaverage5's full aseg, slice views show subregions inside cerebral cortex white matter (rendered grey anatomical context), surrounded neighbouring subcortical structures. Region colours come FreeSurfer's official LUT.

title: Hypothalamic Subunits Atlas — hypothalamus
text: Atlas five FreeSurfer hypothalamic subunits per hemisphere (anterior-inferior, anterior-superior, posterior, tubular-inferior tubular-superior), implemented FreeSurfer's mri_segment_hypothalamic_subunits (Billot et al. 2020). Built cvs_avg35 template segmentation embedded full-brain aseg, slice views show hypothalamus inside cerebral cortex white matter (rendered grey anatomical context). Subunit colours come FreeSurfer's official LUT.

title: Thalamic Nuclei Atlas — thalamus
text: Probabilistic atlas 26 thalamic nuclei per hemisphere combining ex vivo MRI histology, implemented FreeSurfer's segmentThalamicNuclei.sh (Iglesias et al. 2018). Built cvs_avg35 template segmentation embedded full-brain aseg, slice views show thalamus inside cerebral cortex white matter (rendered grey anatomical context). Nucleus colours come FreeSurfer's official LUT — published Iglesias palette.

title: ggsegFreeSurfer 1.0.1.9000
text: Added thalamus(), subcortical atlas 26 thalamic nuclei per hemisphere (Iglesias et al. 2018) Added hippoamyg(), subcortical atlas hippocampal subfields (Iglesias et al. 2015) amygdala nuclei (Saygin et al. 2017) Added brainstem(), subcortical atlas four brainstem substructures: midbrain, pons, medulla superior cerebellar peduncle (Iglesias et al. 2015) Added hypothalamus(), subcortical atlas five hypothalamic subunits per hemisphere (Billot et al. 2020) hcpa() now focused anterior/posterior hippocampus atlas 2D slice geometry (left/right × anterior/posterior), regenerated fsaverage5 aseg. previously carried 3D meshes plot()ted new atlases ship directly sf-optional brain_polygons format introduced 1.0.1, render without sf Subcortical 2D layouts trimmed informative slices (brainstem 3 views, hcpa 2, hypothalamus 4) grey anatomical context geometry simplified, clearer plots smaller bundled data

title: ggsegFreeSurfer 1.0.1
text: Atlas 2D geometry migrated sf-optional brain_polygons format (ggseg.formats 0.0.3). atlases now render without sf GDAL/GEOS/PROJ system libraries, enabling wasm air-gapped installs. Plots unchanged.
